headline: Pinterest (PINS) Taps Renee Jewell For Chief Accounting Officer
summary: Pinterest (NYSE:PINS) appointed Renee Jewell as Chief Accounting Officer, adding a finance leader with experience at Airbnb and eBay. The appointment signals a focus on strengthening accounting oversight and internal financial controls. Jewell's background at large technology companies is expected to inform Pinterest's financial governance and reporting practices.
